title: FBS - Learning System Administrator
description:
Our Client is one of the United States' largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one of the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

About The Role

We are looking for a detail‑oriented and service‑driven professional to act as the main expert for our learning systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the effective administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of our learning platforms, including Cornerstone on Demand and new AI‑based learning solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in Cornerstone administration and demonstrate high learning agility to quickly master new tools and technologies. This position plays a key role in supporting the organization's learning strategy by ensuring systems run smoothly and efficiently.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for Cornerstone on Demand and other learning systems
  • Manage system configurations, updates, integrations, and user support
  • Ensure data accuracy, reporting, and system compliance
  • Support the implementation and optimization of new AI‑driven learning solutions
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and provide timely resolution
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to improve learning processes and user experience
  • Maintain documentation, workflows, and system best practices
  • Provide guidance and training to users when necessary

Requirements

Experience

  • Experience in learning systems administration
  • Strong experience with Cornerstone on Demand
  • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Fluent English (required)

Skills & Capabilities

  • Advanced attention to detail
  • Intermediate written and verbal communication skills
  • Customer‑focused mindset
  • Intermediate decision‑making and problem‑solving skills
  • Strong learning agility and ability to quickly adapt to new technologies

Benefits

This position comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance‑based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office‑based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

Se você é organizado, detalhista e possui forte senso de responsabilidade, este é o seu lugar!

Somos os guardiões da precisão e da integridade financeira da empresa. Aqui você vai mergulhar em processos de controle, auditoria e planejamento orçamentário, garantindo que cada decisão financeira seja tomada com confiança e responsabilidade. Nosso objetivo é garantir a saúde financeira da empresa, mantendo um fluxo de caixa estável e eficiente. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de executar técnicas de negociação, gestão de crédito e relacionamento com clientes, sendo parte fundamental do nosso sucesso. Tem perfil comunicativo e gosta de desafios? Junte-se ao nosso time!

Esse time é especialista em navegar pelo complexo universo da legislação fiscal. Aqui você irá atuar na otimização de carga tributária da empresa, analisar normas fiscais e colaborar em projetos de compliance. Se você tem afinidade com números e adora um bom desafio legal, essa área é a sua cara!

Aqui você será responsável por identificar fontes de financiamento, negociar com investidores e acompanhar as condições de captação. Se você é estratégico, proativo e tem afinidade com o mercado financeiro, este é o seu lugar!

Além de analisar dados financeiros — somos responsáveis por desenvolver estratégias que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável da receita, otimizando preços, promoções e a gestão de canais. Aqui você irá identificar oportunidades de crescimento, analisar tendências de mercado e garantir que as decisões comerciais estejam alinhadas com os objetivos financeiros da empresa. Se você é analítico, estratégico e tem visão para identificar oportunidades de maximizar a receita, este é o seu lugar!


M&A (Fusões e Aquisições): Ajudando a Construir o Futuro da Empresa!

Esse time está sempre em busca de novas oportunidades de crescimento. Aqui você vai avaliar investimentos, realizar due diligence, e participar de negociações que definem o rumo da empresa. É apaixonado por estratégia e mercados financeiros? Venha nos ajudar a construir o futuro!

Somos feras em gerenciar os recursos financeiros — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha sempre o capital necessário para suas operações, além de planejar e controlar os fluxos de caixa, investimentos e financiamentos. Aqui você irá controlar a liquidez da empresa, monitorar contas bancárias e garantir que as operações financeiras aconteçam de maneira eficiente e segura. Se você é detalhista, tem visão estratégica e um forte controle financeiro, este é o seu lugar!

All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

title: Sr. Partner Growth Manager, Amazon Fuse
description:
Are you data driven and like identifying actionable insights that translate into growth initiatives that drive the business? Excel in identifying and communicating mutually beneficial customer and partner propositions and benefits? A creative marketer that can think big and make it happen? Then the Partner Growth Marketing team at Amazon could be the perfect fit for you, where we build dynamic future for Amazon subscriptions across the globe.

The Partner Growth Marketing team (Fuse) within Amazon’s Corporate Business Development group enables partners across multiple verticals to resell our subscription services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited, Kindle Unlimited, and more. You will work with Amazon partners across Brasil and have a direct impact on end customers, seeking to maximize acquisition and customer retention with these partners across existing and new customer segments and offers. Our partners leverage Amazon’s services to drive differentiated offerings and streamlined access for their customers across the globe. We need experienced growth marketing leaders to help us drive great results and grow our established subscription member bases, while help us launch new ones. The team is seeking a talented, self‑directed and high energy growth marketing innovator to help drive our efforts in Brasil, including successful partner launches and strong customer adoption, engagement, and retention. Our ideal candidate will have demonstrated an ability to build successful launch and growth campaigns, by diving deep into the insights around customer data including video streaming and online shopping usage trends, analyzing and reducing churn, while managing the customer lifecycle all the way through the funnel. The candidate must be able to work collaboratively and independently, building trust across internal teams as well as external partners. The focus will be on building, measuring and optimizing successful, results‑oriented marketing programs in a fast‑paced environment, often with speedy timelines, across new partner launches and on‑going campaigns focused on growth marketing efforts that acquire new customers to our subscription services. This person must also have experience in creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale, both directly and by others. Above all, this person must have a passion for understanding what drives a great consumer experience (CX) across both the digital and physical space. The candidate should possess a builder/start‑up mentality and work well in ambiguous situations.

Key job responsibilities

  • Deliver against an annual forecast of Prime and Prime Video subscriptions driven by partners.
  • Collaborating internally and working across cross‑functional teams to deliver best in class campaign opportunities and assets for our partners across Prime, Prime Video, and more.
  • Working closely with partners to understand their customers, how their business operates, their goals and their approach to marketing and content, and owning the end‑to‑end delivery of all partner launches and subsequent growth marketing efforts to drive signups to our subscription services post‑launch.
  • Leading, implementing and launching partner campaign with the North Star to deliver best‑in‑class creative excellence that represents both Prime/Prime Video brand and Fuse offer awareness through a partner.
  • Diving deep into the data to understand insights and learnings, that in turn drive strategy. Lead performance for partners in your region. Share market intelligence and insights with stakeholders and other teammates.
  • Manage end‑to‑end ideation, execution, and analysis/reporting on campaigns including work‑back‑schedules, stakeholder approvals, asset/content set‑up, and subsequent launch.
  • Develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational efficiency of the team and acquisition impact.
  • Creating ongoing marketing programs and propositions for key partners to market our services, and drive customer engagement and retention.
  • Continually optimizing partnerships from launch through to ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in comms, and share of voice (SOV).
  • Diving deep on the customer journey to deliver a great experience and great results.
  • Leading, influencing, and executing integrated go‑to‑market plans with multiple partners in different business verticals and across relevant internal teams.
  • Building ongoing communication channels with and through partners.
  • Partnering with Business Development leads on the sell‑in of new partnerships with pitches, proposals, and B2B communications that bring Amazon’s services and content to life.
  • Experimenting with new ways to drive partnership success.
  • Functioning at a global level, sharing best practices, and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit North America, Latin America, and other regions.

Basic Qualifications

  • +8 years of marketing experience in B2B2C partner‑focused growth marketing across different industries such as: mobile, telecommunications, retail, financial institutions, film, media, music, television or gaming.
  • Ability to view partners as customers, focusing on their needs and goals, and driving great programs for customers that drive great results for partners.
  • Ability to create innovative new programs around entertainment and shopping seasonalities that generate results.
  • Relentless focus on data to make decisions and drive results, able to identify actionable learnings that explain/drive results.
  • Ability to analyze and dive deep on end‑to‑end CX flows to improve customer experience.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with senior management both internally and externally.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi‑partner relationships/projects.
  • Strong bias for action and ownership, and ability to work independently toward stated goals with minimal oversight.
  • A passion for managing details to optimize programs, tools, and creatives. Attention to details to continuously raise the bar.
  • Demonstrated track record in developing, implementing and optimizing multi‑channel, integrated marketing campaigns that focus on growth/performance marketing.
  • Excellent written communications and business case writing skills.
  • Must be willing to travel.
  • Ability to influence and earn trust.
  • High sense of ownership.
  • Business‑level fluency in English (written and verbal).

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA preferred
  • Relevant work experience in integrated partner marketing within the mobile/telecom or related industries, subscriptions, and/or entertainment, financial institutions and sponsorships.
  • Experience in global and/or centralized marketing leadership teams.
  • A passion for video content (film and television) a plus.

Nossos Student Marketeers fazem parte do programa de embaixadores de marca mais dinâmico e capacitado do mundo. Eles entendem o público-alvo da Red Bull e são responsáveis por impulsionar a imagem da marca e a funcionalidade do produto em seu Campus e em sua região. O objetivo do programa Student Markteeer é alcançar novos consumidores, entusiasmar os estudantes universitários, aumentar as vendas e gerenciar a marca Red Bull em seu Campus. Isso inclui o contato direto com consumidores e clientes, convidando a experimentação de produtos, além de trabalhar em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores. Os Student Marketeers valorizam a flexibilidade em um trabalho e adoram trabalhar em um ambiente criativo.

Viva e respire a personalidade da marca e os valores da empresa, representando a marca de forma excepcional através de interações diárias com os consumidores e/ou clientes.
Aumente a base de consumideres convidando pessoas a experimentarem Red Bull, nos lugares certos e no momento certo, respondendo assertivamente a quaisquer perguntas dos consumidores.

Impulsione o envolvimento da marca em suas próprias redes sociais através de conteúdo autêntico.
Trabalhe em eventos da Red Bull e eventos apoiados, para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores.

Construa relacionamentos com clientes locais de pontos de venda e garanta que a Red Bull esteja disponível e visível aos consumidores.
Colabore com as vendas para abrir novos pontos de distribuição para a Red Bull em seu campus e além.
Aproveite os recursos relevantes do mundo Red Bull para manter a marca sempre presente nos clientes locais.
Assegure a execução nos padrões de "loja perfeita".

Demonstre excelência na execução e atenção aos detalhes em todas suas áreas atuantes.
Compartilhe ideias e colabore com a equipe por meio de interações regulares presenciais e online.
Planeje e relate suas atividades através da plataforma online dedicada de forma pontual e precisa.
Contribua para desenvolver as plataformas de mídia da Red Bull fornecendo informações locais, tendências e oportunidades gerais.

Apaixonado(a) pela marca e produto da Red Bull.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
Personalidade carismática, enérgica, positiva e extrovertida.
Imerso(a) na vida estudantil, com amplo entendimento do cenário universitário, cidade e região, incluindo atividades extra curriculares e pontos de interesse.
Muito acessível e sociável, com capacidade de se relacionar com diferentes pessoas em diversas ocasiões.
Possui uma mentalidade criativa e espírito empreendedor, com alto senso de responsabilidade e iniciativa.
Capacidade de conciliar trabalho de meio período e estudos.
Afinidade e desejo de aprender e aplicar uma nova gama de habilidades, especialmente em marketing e vendas.
Conectado(a) com diversos grupos e indivíduos influentes no campus.
Carteira de motorista válida.

Acreditamos no potencial de todas as pessoas para dar aaasas a ideias independente de expressão de gênero, raça, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, idade e deficiência. No mundo da Red Bull todas as pessoas são bem-vindas.

title: Operations Manager, Logistics
description:
Company Overview

Nestig is a direct-to-consumer brand with a mission to create the most delightful place to shop for children’s spaces. Our brand is synonymous with quality, care, and trust, offering customers a seamless shopping experience and exceptional products for their little ones. As one of the fastest-growing consumer brands since 2021, Operations is essential to our culture, and we believe this is a key part of what sets us apart from the competition. We strive to execute streamlined, backend logistics to ensure customers receive their items in a timely and secure way.

Department Overview

As part of Nestig’s Operations team, you will play a strategic, hands‑on leadership role overseeing the full Customs and Logistics function across Brazil, North America, Europe, and Asia. Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will manage a team of three and lead critical logistics operations, people development, and global partner relationships. You will navigate complex cross‑border challenges while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization across the supply chain. In close partnership with Scheduling, Customer Experience, and Product Development, you will ensure efficient end‑to‑end product movement: from manufacturing and export through warehousing, customs clearance, last‑mile delivery, and customer satisfaction.

This full-time position will be based out of our São Paulo office in Pinheiros.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of three direct reports across varying levels, fostering continuous growth and high-performance culture through clear expectation setting, structured feedback, effective delegation, and hands‑on support when needed;
  • Own end‑to‑end international import and export workflows, managing and negotiating with global carrier partners to resolve escalations and meet cost, performance, and service‑level benchmarks;
  • Manage operations across all U.S. partner warehouses, ensuring accurate inventory, SLA compliance, and continuous process improvement;
  • Develop, monitor, and refine KPIs for team performance, compliance, and operational excellence, using data‑driven insights to measure success and inform company‑wide improvements;
  • Design streamlined processes that reduce transit delays, losses, and damage across all operations, working closely with the Product Development team to enhance packaging quality while maintaining competitive shipping costs;
  • Oversee tracking processes, ensuring proactive communication and rapid issue resolution across customs and internal teams;
  • Manage and onboard white glove delivery partners, ensuring quality standards, customer satisfaction, and ongoing partner development;
  • Lead freight cost optimization initiatives, driving savings through commercial negotiations, operational redesign, and carrier performance reviews;
  • Own carrier invoice and import tax validation processes, ensuring accuracy and preventing financial leakage;
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert for logistics and fulfillment operations, equipping the team with the knowledge and guidance needed to address inquiries across carriers, customs, and end‑to‑end supply chain workflows.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years experience in Logistics and Operations, with at least 2 years in a people‑management role.
  • Must be able to work onsite in our São Paulo office in Pinheiros (Fradique Coutinho subway station) three (3) days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday).
  • Experience in a early‑stage, growth‑oriented within fast‑paced company, or global operations is strongly preferred
  • Excellent communications skills in Portuguese and English (Level B2), both verbal and written, with a knack for creative problem‑solving, negotiation and calm, confident conflict resolution.
  • A passion for talent development and team management, giving structured feedback, delegating effectively and fostering a collaborative and motivational environment.
  • Fast learner with sharp problem‑solving and negotiation skills and excellent judgment.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.
  • Hands‑on and proactive when needed, while still operating with a strategic, managerial approach.
  • Highly analytical, data‑driven mindset with the ability to transform data into strategies and operational improvements.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI is a plus.
  • A passion for building processes, improving operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Ability to embody and exercise Nestig's Core Values in all facets of the business.
  • Legal authorization to work in Brazil (We are available to hire as Freelancer ("PF") or Contractor ("PJ")).

Why You’ll Love Working Here!

  • Total Rewards: dive into our TOTAL REWARDS DECK to learn more about Nestig’s benefits and perks
  • Comprehensive medical benefits through Alice for you and your loved onesTwenty-one (21) business days* per calendar year, prorated from your start date, so you can take your well‑earned R&R (*What is a business day? A business day is a weekday that the business is open (non‑governmental holiday weekdays). This means that PTO requests will not need to include weekend day(s) and/or governmental holiday(s) that hug a particular day you are requesting off.)
  • Flexible Work From Wherever (WFW) Policy — up to five (5) weeks of remote work per year, prorated from your start date
  • Monthly wellness, IT, and commuter stipend
  • WFW stipend, so you are able to create a comfortable working environment at home
  • Annual education stipend, because we are always learning
  • Nestig discount, so you can treat you, your family & loved ones!
  • Paid parental leave of sixteen (16) weeks after six (6) months of employment for birthing and non‑birthing parents.

What will this interview process look like?

  • We believe that interviews should be a two‑way street — an opportunity for us to get to know you, and for you to learn about life at Nestig. To help you feel prepared and confident, we’ve outlined each step of this recruitment process HERE.

Nestig is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, national origin, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected class. We believe that diversity is more than just good intentions, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Descrição

O SESI SP está em busca de profissionais para compor nosso Banco de Talentos em todo o Estado de São Paulo. Inscreva-se e venha transformar o futuro da educação e da indústria com a gente!!!

O que faz o Guarda Vidas do SESI-SP?

Realiza procedimentos de primeiros socorros e evitar acidentes. Desenvolve ações educativas sobre prevenção, cumprir e instruir funcionários, alunos, atletas e usuários quanto as diretrizes do Princípio Acidente Zero. Realiza práticas preventivas e simulações de salvamento e primeiros socorros. Desenvolve o treinamento de Guarda Vidas temporários.

Local de trabalho:

Confira aqui as cidades disponíveis.

Requisitos

  • Ensino de médio completo
  • Curso de Guarda-Vidas (Salva-Vidas), ou Curso de Socorrista ou Curso de Primeiros Socorros , com carga horária mínima de 12 horas, ou Disciplina de Primeiros Socorros, concluída, em curso de Nível Superior, ou 03 meses de experiência, comprovada, como Guarda-Vidas ou em função de Socorrista na área de saúde.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ NO DIA A DIA

  • Técnicas de natação, abordagem e desvencilhamento de vítimas.
  • Técnicas e agilidade nas ações de salvamento e primeiros socorros.
  • Anatomia Humana: características e funções dos aparelhos locomotor, respiratório e circulatório.
  • Teoria da Recuperação Cardio Respiratória.
  • Avaliação de cenário
  • Avaliação da vítima: identificação, recuperação e preservação dos sinais vitais.
  • Avaliação do quadro clínico: hemorragias, fraturas, torções, ferimentos, queimaduras, hipertermia, hipotermia, estado de choque e lesões raquimedulares.
  • Graus de afogamento.
  • Princípios teóricos da prevenção: fase da prevenção, medidas de segurança do socorrista, técnicas para otimização do socorro.
  • Técnicas de judô aquático

ATENÇÃO! É IMPORTANTE VOCÊ SABER

  • O contato com os candidatos inscritos se dará somente no surgimento de vaga, pois trata-se de BANCO DE TALENTOS.
  • A inscrição no Banco de Talentos visa a formação de um cadastro reserva para todo o Estado de São Paulo. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.
  • Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação.
  • A participação nas etapas do processo seletivo (como entrevistas, avaliações ou aulas-teste) poderá ocorrer de forma presencial ou online.
  • Caso alguma etapa seja realizada online, o acesso à internet e os equipamentos necessários são de responsabilidade da pessoa candidata. Relembramos também que eventuais falhas de conexão, de equipamentos ou a não visualização do e-mail de agendamento poderão impedir a realização, e não haverá possibilidade de reagendamento.
  • Toda comunicação será realizada exclusivamente por e-mail, por isso pedimos que você mantenha seus dados atualizados e verifique sua caixa de entrada, inclusive o spam.
  • É permitida apenas uma inscrição por candidato(a). Se identificada, a qualquer momento, duplicidade de inscrição, caberá a exclusão do processo seletivo.
  • As datas das etapas podem ser agendadas com até 24h de antecedência.
  • Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo.
  • Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.
  • Importante: Nos locais onde exista cadastro reserva vigente, estes terão prioridade no preenchimento das vagas que surgirem. Somente após o esgotamento de candidatos ou término da vigência, utilizaremos esse Banco de Talentos.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Acreditamos que equipes diversas entregam resultados inovadores, possuem maior representatividade e maior impacto social. Por isso, convidamos profissionais de diferentes trajetórias, habilidades e perspectivas para enriquecerem o nosso ambiente de trabalho com suas experiências únicas.

title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.
The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.
These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 3-7 weeks from CV screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Potential in-person follow-up interview.
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

title: Technical Support Automation Specialist
description:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What You’ll Do

As a Technical Support Automation Specialist at TRACTIAN, you will serve as the bridge between technical support and automation engineering, providing high-level technical assistance to our clients and ensuring robust integration of our monitoring solutions in industrial environments. You will be responsible for validating, implementing, and maintaining industrial communication systems, integrating PLCs and sensors, interpreting electrical diagrams, and ensuring system performance. You will also act as a technical reference during the implementation and post-implementation phases, supporting both on-site and remote operations.


Responsibilities
  • Provide technical support for automation-related issues, ensuring the correct operation and integration of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring platforms.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems involving industrial communication protocols, electrical diagrams, and control systems.
  • Interpret and adjust electrical diagrams and PLC logic during installations or support requests.
  • Collaborate with Hardware, Data Science, and Product teams to improve hardware-software integration in industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of electrical equipment and networks, as well as terminology related to this field and their applications: power factor, phase diagram, consumption, reactive power, phases, etc
  • Provide both remote and on-site support to ensure customer satisfaction and reduce downtime.
  • Document technical cases, customer interactions, and solutions through our Helpdesk and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Assist in identifying technical opportunities for upsell, expansion, or system optimization.
  • Share knowledge internally and contribute to the creation of technical documentation related to automation and industrial integration.
Bonus Points
  • Fluent in English.
  • Previous experience in B2B technical support roles or industrial automation projects.
  • Experience with sensor installation and sizing (vibration, temperature, pressure, flow, etc.).
  • Knowledge of SCADA/DCS systems and industrial instrumentation.

Job Description

Curitiba - PR

O Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Venha e junte-se a nós como você é, porque acreditamos que pontos de vista diversos nos tornam mais fortes e inovadores. Dentro da nossa comunidade global com pessoas de mais de cem países, nós ouvimos uns aos outros, e ativamente colaboramos e crescemos em diversidade e inclusão. Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!

Há mais de cem anos, o Electrolux Group vem trabalhando para transformar a vida para melhor, desenvolvendo e fabricando produtos que atendam às necessidades das pessoas no que diz respeito a sabor, cuidado e bem-estar. As equipes de TI do Electrolux Group têm a missão de criar soluções otimizadas para o futuro do negócio, entregando experiências extraordinárias através do uso de tecnologias tradicionais e novas. É a atuação proativa delas que permite que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação dentro da jornada do consumidor.

O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar como principal elo entre os stakeholders de negócios da área de Manufatura e a TI, garantindo alinhamento das iniciativas tecnológicas com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Conduzir projetos de transformação digital na manufatura, com foco em otimização de processos e integração de sistemas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de manufatura por meio da tecnologia e propor soluções inovadoras.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações de manufatura, incluindo levantamento de requisitos, priorização e coordenação com equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir conformidade com governança de TI, gestão de mudanças e padrões de cibersegurança no ambiente de manufatura.
  • Facilitar workshops e reuniões com líderes de negócio, gerentes de planta e equipes de TI para definir requisitos e entregar soluções.
  • Monitorar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos sistemas de manufatura, recomendando melhorias quando necessário.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico para iniciativas da Indústria 4.0, incluindo IoT, automação e soluções de fábrica inteligente.
  • Fornecer orientação e mentoria para membros da equipe e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento entre TI e manufatura.

Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / C2W).

Quem você é

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência em TI e gestão de relacionamento com negócios, preferencialmente em ambiente de manufatura.
  • Sólido conhecimento de processos e sistemas de manufatura (MES, ERP, PLM).
  • Experiência com iniciativas de transformação digital, incluindo tecnologias da Indústria 4.0 (IoT, automação, fábrica inteligente).
  • Familiaridade com plataformas ERP e soluções MES (preferência por Delmia Apriso).
  • Compreensão sólida de integração IT/OT e fundamentos de cibersegurança.
  • Experiência desejável na gestão de projetos em múltiplas fases do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de relatórios e análise (Power BI, SSRS) e proficiência em SQL.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Onde você vai estar

Você vai atuar na planta do Guabirotuba, em Curitiba. Um dos principais eixos das operações da Electrolux na América Latina, essa planta é a base para mais de 3200 colaboradores, todos focados em transformar a vida para o melhor com o seu trabalho.

  • Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;
  • Participação nos lucros anuais;
  • Acesso ao Gympass;
  • Amplas oportunidades de aprendizado e flexibilidade de carreira.

Também oferecemos licença maternidade de 6 meses e benefício mínimo de licença paternidade de 4 semanas para novos pais; esta novidade é uma diretriz global e garante a valorização de todos - não importa quem sejam, em que país estejam, ou que função exercem na empresa.

Como parte do Electrolux Group, vamos investir continuamente em você e no seu desenvolvimento. Não existem barreiras para onde sua carreira pode te levar.

About the job Medical Document Retrieval Specialist (Brazil | Remote)

Medical Document Retrieval Specialist (Remote)

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

The Medical Document Retrieval Specialist plays a pivotal role in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. As the first step in the workflow, this position ensures all requests are complete, accurate, and prepared for downstream processing. The quality of intake directly impacts the speed and accuracy of records retrieval for our law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Determine all relevant healthcare providers associated with a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
  • Locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, prior request history, and direct provider calls.
  • Input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

  • Review and correct incoming Release of Information (ROI) forms, which are incomplete or incorrect in approximately 90% of cases.
  • Create accurate base forms before assembling final submission packets.
  • Conduct thorough quality assurance checks for each ROI packet, ensuring all required components (cover letters, affidavits, etc.) are accurate and complete.

3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to appropriate records team members based on workload and utilization metrics.
  • Identify and elevate provider-specific requirements (e.g., custom forms) to the appropriate Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing or conflicting information by liaising directly with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of healthcare companies, law firms, or related organizations.
  • Attention to Detail: Extreme accuracy is essential errors can cause months-long delays in retrieval.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Adobe Acrobat and PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

Somos mais de 2400 colaboradores que atuam nas regiões norte (Pará) e Nordeste (Piauí, Maranhão, Bahia e Rio Grande do Norte)

O reconhecimento não tardou a vir, através dos prêmios Top Of Mind e Top Marketing Brasil, em 2010, o prêmio Top Natal de 2009 a 2019, que destaca a rede como a farmácia mais lembrada no Rio Grande do Norte, e a conquista do prêmio Marcas Inesquecíveis, em Teresina (PI), em 2018.

Todos os dias a Drogaria Globo abre suas portas com a inspiração de entender cada vez mais o consumidor e atender suas necessidades, sempre com o sorriso no rosto e a disponibilidade de uma equipe comprometida e com o único objetivo: cuidar acima de tudo!

title: Senior Business Operations (BizOps) Analyst
description:
Senior Business Operations (BizOps) Analyst

Sao Paulo - Brazil

Operation & Strategy - Mobility
Regular

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

Our EV & Sustainable Solutions team is part of Driver Lab , 99’s innovation hub dedicated to our partner drivers. Our mission is to forge strategic partnerships and develop and implement cutting-edge products and solutions that drive efficiency and profitability for 99.

In this role, your primary focus will be developing business cases for new driver-centric programs.

The ideal candidate is highly data-driven , possesses strong analytical and critical thinking skills, and is a proactive professional who excels at building relationships with both cross-functional internal teams and external partners.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between users, partners, and internal support teams.
  • Partnership Negotiation: Lead negotiations with strategic partners and vendors to secure favorable terms and drive business growth.
  • Strategic Project Management: Drive projects from conception to execution, managing timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables to achieve business goals.
  • Data Analysis: Conduct comprehensive data analysis across operational, financial, commercial, and market-related domains.
  • Executive Reporting: Prepare high-impact reports and executive-level presentations to support decision-making.
  • KPI Management: Structure and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for all strategic initiatives.
  • Commercial Agreements: Draft and negotiate commercial proposals and service-level agreements (SLAs) with a focus on long-term value.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience integrating data analysis, project management, and executive communication to drive business growth and operational efficiency. (Mandatory)
  • Core Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, critical thinking, and excellent communication skills. (Mandatory)
  • Soft Skills: Proactive mindset, autonomy, eagerness to learn, and a collaborative team-player attitude. (Mandatory)
  • Languages: Advanced English proficiency. (Mandatory)
  • Spreadsheets: Advanced skills in Excel and Google Sheets. (Mandatory)
  • Presentations: Advanced skills in PowerPoint and Google Slides. (Mandatory)
  • Technical Skills: Intermediate SQL. (Mandatory)
  • Data Visualization: Foundational knowledge of Data Viz tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Power BI, ThinkCell). (Mandatory)
  • Interests: A genuine passion for Electric Mobility.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value: We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven: We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration: Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity: Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth: We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion: Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

description:
Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Consórcio

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Main responsibilities

Estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em Consórcios . Se você já possui experiência na área ou deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um dos segmentos mais tradicionais e estratégicos da Rodobens, esta é a oportunidade ideal para se conectar conosco.

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras posições alinhadas às suas competências e ao seu potencial de crescimento. Buscamos pessoas que desejam contribuir para soluções financeiras capazes de transformar vidas e apoiar clientes na realização de seus projetos.

Se você quer construir sua trajetória conosco e fazer parte de uma empresa referência no mercado de consórcios, cadastre seu currículo e participe do nosso Banco de Talentos.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos:

  • Profissionais com experiência ou forte interesse em produtos de consórcio;
  • Perfil consultivo, com forte habilidade em construir e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo e orientado para resultados, com foco no cliente;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Vivência em vendas, relacionamento com clientes ou rotinas administrativas será um diferencial.

Additional information

Nossas oportunidades estão distribuídas em todas as regiões do Brasil!

Benefícios pra você!

  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica

  • Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados
  • Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens

Professor(a) Regente de Inglês - Infantil - Salvador/BA

Localização: Salvador, BR

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Gurilândia e a Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) Regente de Inglês para o Infantil. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas como Professor(a) Regente de Inglês alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência com Infantil;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

description:
Que tal integrar o quadro de colaboradores de uma instituição cujo valores de atuação são baseados no amor e na humanização?

O Hospital de Amor conta com diversas unidades hospitalares, acredita e desenvolve a sua equipe constantemente, proporcionando um bom clima organizacional e o bem-estar no ambiente de trabalho.

Nosso propósito é a prestação de serviços ao paciente do Sistema Único de Saúde na prevenção, com diagnósticos, realização de tratamento, ensino e pesquisa em oncologia.

Nos últimos anos estamos intensificando o processo de Transformação Digital da instituição com intuito dar ainda mais qualidade aos nossos serviços. Nesse contexto surge o Laboratório de Inteligência Artificial Aplicada à Oncologia, um projeto financiado pelo Ministério da Ciência, tecnologia e Inovação.

Venha fazer parte do projeto que utilizará tecnologia e inovação para humanizar cada vez mais o tratamento oncológico na saúde pública do nosso país.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para a função de Cientista de Dados I.

Saiba mais:

Vaga Temporária Projeto de 24 meses

PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES DESEMPENHADAS PELO CARGO

  • Treinar/aplicar modelos de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN) para extração de características clínicas a partir de textos de laudos de exames e evoluções médicas;
  • Auxiliar no gerenciamento do projeto principal, elaboração de novos projetos, relatórios e resumos para eventos científicos;
  • Realizar outras demandas relacionadas a extração de informação a partir de textos;
  • Comunicar os resultados.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em cursos relacionados a Tecnologia da Informação ou Saúde;
  • Experiência profissional ou acadêmica de, pelo menos, 2 anos com PLN;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python e SQL;
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina no contexto de PLN (regressão logística, SVM, k-NN, árvore de decisão, random forest, rede neural recorrente, rede neural convolucional, BERT, entre outros);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Pensamento científico, espírito colaborativo, proatividade e boa comunicação.
  • Conhecimento desejável:
  • Experiência com PLN no contexto clínico;
  • Experiência com ambientes de Cloud (GCP) e servidores GPU (Nvidia);
  • Pensamento Lean Digital.

CARGA HORÁRIA

Das 08:00 às 18:00 - segunda a quinta-feira;

Das 08:00 às 17:00 - sexta-feira;

Quais serão as etapas?

  1. Cadastro do currículo: O candidato deve descrever a sua trajetória de forma clara e completa, especialmente a formação, especialização e experiência profissional;
  2. Análise de currículos: A equipe de atração e seleção avaliará os currículos e aqueles que atenderem aos pré-requisitos receberão o contato (e-mail ou telefone) para agendar a próxima etapa;

  7. Retorno aos candidatos: Todos os candidatos avaliados no processo seletivo receberão o retorno do time de atração e seleção através do e-mail.
  8. Preparação para admissão: O candidato aprovado realiza exame admissional e providencia documentação para contratação. Etapa eliminatória;
  9. Admissão: O candidato aprovado em todas as etapas anteriores é admitido conforme calendário interno e participa da acolhida institucional (Onboarding).

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no atendimento de tickets escalados (N2), realizando análise de causa raiz e propondo soluções definitivas.
  • Operar, configurar e evoluir chatbots e agentes de IA para atendimento (intents, fluxos, automações, handoff, curadoria e melhoria contínua).
  • Criar, manter e otimizar automações de atendimento e backoffice integrando Chatbot, HubSpot, Jira e demais sistemas via n8n, webhooks e APIs .

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores como SLA, TMA, FCR, backlog, reincidência e CSAT .

  • Conhecimento sólido em CRMs , preferencialmente HubSpot (tickets, workflows, automações e relatórios).
  • Experiência com plataformas de gestão de conversas e tickets (omnichannel).
  • Vivência com automações de processos usando ferramentas como n8n, HubSpot Workflows, APIs REST e webhooks .
  • Capacidade analítica para diagnóstico de problemas, leitura técnica e documentação clara.
  • Comunicação estruturada e orientada a resolução.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com integrações via API e arquitetura de automações end‑to‑end (chatbot → CRM → Jira → BI).
  • Conhecimento em SQL, análise de logs ou ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, etc.).
  • Vivência com event‑driven automation e orquestração de fluxos no n8n .
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala , múltiplos produtos e alta complexidade operacional.

Conhecimento avançado em

  • Mikrotik RouterOS – roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS, firewall e VPN;

Estamos buscando um Consultor de Negócios que se alinhe aos valores da ECO Consultoria e que possua as seguintes qualificações:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Nível superior completo, preferencialmente nas áreas de Administração, Recursos Humanos, Marketing ou Comercial.

  • Comunicação e Persuasão: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e persuasão, capazes de desenvolver scripts eficientes e abordar doadores de forma ética e assertiva.
  • Adaptação às Tecnologias: Capacidade de entender e integrar novas tecnologias e sistemas de gestão.

  • Disponibilidade para Viajar: O consultor deve ter disponibilidade para viagens, atendendo a demandas presenciais, treinamentos e reuniões em diferentes localidades onde a ECO Consultoria atua.

Benefícios:

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

As a Mechanical Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions.   • Experience with manufacturing and production processes, including machining, plastic injection molding, casting, and forming.
  • Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Technical English proficiency for reading and writing.

Bonus points

  • Experience with CAE simulation (Fusion Simulation, SolidWorks Simulation, or similar tools).
  • Experience with high-aesthetic standard injected products, including in-depth knowledge of plastic injection molding processes and technical application details.
